Sai ua is `a famous grilled pork sausage from Northern Thailand packed with lemongrass, galangal, and red curry paste` . Its name translates to "stuffed intestine", reflecting how it is made.[](https://twoguysandacooler.com/thai-sai-ua/) [[1]](https://twoguysandacooler.com/thai-sai-ua/)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/100063768574675/posts/ready-for-everyone-sai-ua-northern-thai-sausage-khun-ya-thai-supermarket-made-ho/1488074383328167/)[[3]](https://www.facebook.com/ManstonFoodsThailand/posts/sai-ua-also-known-as-chiang-mai-sausage-is-a-renowned-northern-thai-delicacy-cel/1080566777437990/)

Ingredients and Flavor

- **Coarse pork** : Fatty minced pork mixed with herbs.
- **Aromatics** : Lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime leaves, and fresh turmeric.
- **Spices** : Red curry paste, garlic, shallots, and fish sauce.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/sai-ua/) [[1]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/sai-ua/)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sai_oua)[[3]](https://ianbenites.com/sai-ua-northern-thai-sausage-%E0%B9%84%E0%B8%AA%E0%B9%89%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B1%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%A7/)[[4]](https://guide.michelin.com/th/en/article/features/a-guide-to-thai-sausages-and-where-to-find-them)

How It Is Served

- **Sticky rice** : Paired together as a classic northern meal.
- **Fresh vegetables** : Eaten with raw cabbage, cucumbers, and herbs.
- **Street food** : Popular as a snack or starter across Thailand.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/sai-ua/) [[1]](https://www.facebook.com/HotThaiKitchen/videos/northern-thai-sausage-recipe-sai-ua-%E0%B9%84%E0%B8%AA%E0%B9%89%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%B1%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%A7-thai-recipes/208931161355252/)
